campaigns.name: Automatic Podcast Censoring
campaigns.objective: Acquire Cast users by positioning built-in automatic censoring as a faster alternative to manually finding and bleeping explicit language.
campaigns.audience: Independent podcasters / small teams whose episodes contain explicit language and who do their own post; monetize or want a cleaner version for wider distribution; unscripted formats (comedy, interview, commentary).
campaigns.problem: Manually censoring is slow and repetitive — every occurrence found, edited, timed, checked.
solution: Replace with sounds, not just a beep
campaigns.angle: Censoring should be part of podcast editing — not another job after it. 'Another production step' → 'Already handled inside Cast.'
campaigns.coreMessage: What if podcast censoring was automatic?
campaigns.extra: Custom censoring beyond profanity — names, brands, sensitive terms, or 'unnecessary censorship' comedy where ordinary words get bleeped for effect. Multilingual profanity dictionary built in.
